content.text:
Fusing all four into one playable game — now building it.

**My take:** A top-down Zelda-style overworld (slash + buster-blaster, heart drops, caves), Metroid-style Morph Ball to squeeze through gaps and roll over spikes, and a tower defense core: build turrets on pads to defend the Triforce Crystal while Armos-style bots march down the path. 12 waves, boss at wave 12, upgrades, mobile touch too.
